title: Lagrangian Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the Lagrangian in the center of mass system as L = (mu/2)(dot(r)^2 + r^2 dot(theta)^2) - V(r).

title: Energy Conservation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must show that the total energy E = (1/2)mu dot(r)^2 + (J^2)/(2mu r^2) + V(r) is conserved.

title: Angular Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate that angular momentum J = mu r^2 dot(theta) is constant.

title: Kepler's Second Law
description: Important Criteria: The student must prove that the motion satisfies Kepler's second law, indicating that r^2 dot(theta) is constant.

title: Extreme Values of r
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the equation k mu r^4 - 2E mu r^2 + J^2 = 0 for the maximum and minimum values of r.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all terms in the energy equation have consistent units.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the Lagrangian or energy equations.
